subject: 🎙️ Claude Meetings joins Google Meet live, builds docs in real time
intro: Anthropic had quite a week. Claude joins your meetings, runs agents on your own servers, and their researchers just proved that cleaning up poisoned training data can triple misalignment. That last one should keep safety teams up at night. The pattern is clear: Anthropic is going deep into enterprise infrastructure, not just the API layer. The safety paper is the real sleeper. We thought clean data was the cure. Turns out it can be the accelerant.

news.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to join video calls and build docs live
news.body: Your team is mid-call, someone says "let's write this up" and... nothing happens until after. Claude Meetings fixes that gap. Anthropic just dropped a beta that lets Claude join your Google Meet call as a visible participant. It listens, and starts working while you are still talking. Here is what it actually does during the call: When the call ends, everything Claude built, notes, transcript, docs, lands on a dedicated page in claude.ai. No chasing people for summaries. On privacy: Claude saves a transcript but not audio , and by default it leaves if outside guests join the call. It is live in beta for Team and Enterprise plans on Google Meet, with more platforms coming later.
bullets: Answers questions you ask out loud or in chat
Builds docs and whiteboards in real time as the conversation unfolds
Takes notes and logs action items automatically
Pulls data from connected work apps when you give it permission

news.headline: Anthropic opens private beta for self-hosted Claude agents on your own cloud
news.body: Anthropic just dropped self-hosted Claude Managed Agents into private beta, and it's a big deal for teams that can't send sensitive data to outside servers. Here's the simple version: Claude Managed Agents is an AI that runs tasks on its own, like an autopilot for your codebase. Until now, Anthropic ran all the infrastructure behind it. Now you can run it yourself, on your own servers or cloud account. What stays in your environment: This opens up tasks that were previously off-limits, like fixing broken builds , triaging alerts, and managing bug backlogs, all with access to your internal systems. It's private beta only right now, limited to eligible orgs. To get in, reach out to your Anthropic account team.
bullets: The agent server, database, and sandboxes (isolated workspaces where code runs safely)
Your credentials and session history, so nothing leaks out
Your choice of model provider: Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Google, or your own internal gateway

news.headline: Anthropic files for its initial public offering with the SEC
news.body: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, is going public. This is a big deal for anyone who has been building with their AI tools. Here is what you need to know: What does this mean for you? Anthropic now has access to massive public capital, which means more compute, faster model releases, and continued API investment. The tools you build on top of Claude are backed by a company with serious runway.
bullets: Ticker: ANT on Nasdaq -- that is where you will find the stock once trading opens
Share price range: $70-$78 , with 825 million shares on offer to the public
Valuation: $1.3T to $1.45T -- putting it in the same conversation as the biggest tech companies alive
Revenue grew over 1,200% year-over-year, hitting $33.2 billion in the first nine months of 2026
You can buy shares through Schwab, Fidelity, Robinhood, SoFi, and E-Trade
